profile.headline: Software Engineer at IBM
profile.summary: Advisory Software Engineer with experience in Full-Stack Development, Mobile Development, Robotics, Machine Learning and DevOps.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer
positions.description:
Within my time at IBM I have I have zero-to-one launched three different offerings to market both as a Full Stack IC Developer or as a Squad Lead and Architect including: Watson Candidate Assistant, the watsonx Orchestrate Agent Developer Kit and the watsonx Orchestate Developer Edition with more in the works. As Squad Lead of the ADK and Developer Edition I helped grow a community of over 2000 IBMers across the company who in turn act as evangelists for the product outside it.

I’ve gained a wide breadth of business knowledge across six different Business Units seeking impact including: Systems, Digital, Talent Managment, Consulting, Research, and Data and AI. 


My areas of focus have been in Assistant and Agentic end user experiences, talent, research, data analytics, and devops.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Lab assistant at a Human Robotics Interaction Lab focused on integrating Google Glass, and Project Tango (a phone with a built in structured light sensor), to build a command and control system combining human and robot actors for the purposes of disaster recovery.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed a web based dashboard for the ODM product.  The dashboard provided the means to do real time debugging, testing and acted as a demonstration tool.  Technologies utilized include websockets on the liberty server, J2EE, OSGi, and dojo.

positions.title: Startup CTO
positions.description: Hive Labs co-founder. Developing a Software as a Service (SaaS) layer over Node.JS known as OpenSaaS.  OpenSaas is being built to facilitate a highly distributed, scaleable, multi-application web stack.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed demonstrations utilizing IBM's ODM product to both showcase its capabilities and validate acceptance criteria.  Demos included hospital management and the wi-fi based localization of non-managed actors.

educations.schoolName: Leominster High School Center for Technical Education

projects.title: OpenSaaS
projects.description: OpenSaaS is a distributed Software as a Service (SaaS) stack built over node.js.  The intention of OpenSaaS is to provide a reliable Software as a Service platform that can be run in any public, private or hybrid cloud, in house or on the public internet to provide a platform for the simple creation, distribution and interoperability of web based applications.

projects.title: Notoja
projects.description: Notoja is an artificially intelligent word processing application targeted towards academia.  Notoja's purpose is to augment the learning experience of taking notes and writing reports by providing a stable, safe, place for students to take notes and write reports while leveraging the power of the internet and modern advancements in artificial intelligence to suggest resources that would further their current writing interest.
